subject: Discovery recap — trial success ladder and delivery rhythm
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — trial success ladder and delivery rhythm

Hi Claire — great to meet this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed lightweight trial plan so Novapay can validate latency, cost per inference, and end-to-end reliability against your fraud-detection workflow. See the attached POC-success-ladder.xlsx (high-level phases).

Recap (2 key goals):
- Business: reduce manual review load on flagged transactions by 30% while keeping precision > 95% on high-risk alerts.
- Engineering: sub-200ms median token latency for short-context inference (<= 128 tokens) and predictable cost per thousand requests under projected throughput.

Proposed success ladder (three checkpoints):
1) Sandbox integration (week 0–1) — verify connectivity, sample inference run, SSO + network allowlist. Acceptance: sample run with synthetic dataset, logs visible in Console.
2) Closed pilot (week 2–3) — run on a 10k txn/day slice with live traffic shadowing. Acceptance: accuracy and latency targets met for 3 consecutive days, no PII egress events.
3) Readout & handoff (week 4) — final results, runbook, and rollback plan. Acceptance: internal stakeholders sign-off and decision to commit to Dedicated or Hosted SLA.

Owners & asks:
- Dylan Brooks (me): commercial touch, coordinate kickoffs and decision gates.
- Soojin Lee (SE): technical preflight and weekly check-ins.
- Marissa Cole (CS): onboarding cadence and success metrics dashboard.

Pre-kickoff asks for your team:
- Confirm kickoff week: propose Apr 21 or Apr 28.
- Provide a small synthetic sample (anonymized) or pointer to where we can pull 1,000 sample transactions.
- Add security@novapay.com to the thread for the network/KYC questions.

Attachments: POC-success-ladder.xlsx (spreadsheet), network-preflight-checklist.pdf (attachment stub).

If Apr 21 works I’ll lock a 30-minute kickoff and send a short agenda (tech preflight + success criteria + data access).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks — looping in technical preflight details below so we can hit the ground running on Apr 21. I’ve attached a short tech-preflight-notes.md for the infra team.

Preflight (high level):
- Network: IP allowlist / proxy details or VPN termination (we support outbound-only). Please confirm whether we need an allowlist or can work through your NAT.
- Auth: API key vs mTLS vs SSO. For pilot, API key with strict scope is fine; for production we recommend mTLS or VPC peering.
- Data: send 1,000 anonymized rows in CSV; include a small schema doc. No PII in the trial dataset.
- Observability: grant read access to the trial Console dashboard (token-level cost + latency) for Miguel and Claire.
- Rollback: default policy is immediate fallback to shadow mode and retention purge after 30 days unless otherwise agreed.

Owner tasks before kickoff: 
- Marissa: please prepare the shared success dashboard template and an initial checklist we can copy to the Drive folder.
- Dylan: confirm who on the Novapay side will own the Drive link and the infra contact for allowlist.
- Soojin: I’ll run an internal preflight with infra on Apr 19 to verify the call patterns and sample inference runs.

Attachment: tech-preflight-notes.md (text).

Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
